description:
Configuration Inference Class

Builds the configuration inputs required to run an inference workflow.

It defines the priors, samples them to obtain the parameter distribution (theta) and assembles a feature dictionary used for later feature-extraction.

arguments.prior_min: Lower bound of the prior parameters range (inclusive).
arguments.prior_max: Upper bound of the prior parameters range (exclusive).
arguments.num_sim: Number of samples to draw from the prior distribution, used by the sample_posterior function.
arguments.seed: Random seed for reproducible sampling. If None, no seed is set.
arguments.domain_cfg: List of feature domains to extract. If None, all domains are returned. Valid domains are: 'hmm', 'spectral', 'connectivity', 'temporal', 'statistical', 'information', 'catch22'.
arguments.names_cfg: Features names to extract. Can be a single string or a list/tuple. If None, returns the original cfg.
arguments.json_path_cfg: Path to a JSON file defining features. If None, the default features.json bundled with the package is used.
